1b05d0a28e21.text: A fly-brain route from curiosity to understanding.

429b68e56684.text: Why education belongs in the project

bd6599350f72.text: A decision has to be practised.

c38b4014b3d9.text: Education is a right, and a way for people to take part in decisions that affect them. Article 26 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and SDG 4 give that commitment a public foundation; Target 4.7 connects learning to sustainable development. For AeroSense, it means making the science accessible enough to question, use and eventually build on.

d5e3e4c250f7.text: Our initial survey changed the question we wanted to ask. Explaining that mold can be dangerous was too broad. Our working summary pointed instead to decisions people make about heat, smell and visible spoilage. We therefore built opportunities to choose an answer, see why it matters and try a new situation. The team now reports 107 responses; item-level counts still need verification, so this page does not turn the early summary into population percentages.

5432ac2be556.text: Active participation gave us a useful starting point. Freeman and colleagues' synthesis of 225 undergraduate STEM studies found an average 0.47-standard-deviation improvement in examination performance with active learning. Wouters and colleagues found benefits of serious games for learning and retention, with no clear overall motivation advantage. Those results justify testing an approach; they do not establish that our own games work.

0eb9944632a3.text: We also wanted a conversation about synthetic biology itself. What does it mean to put a fruit-fly odor receptor into cultured HEK293 cells? What can a fluorescent response tell us? Who should act on a screening result? Each activity below gives a different audience a way into those questions.

e6ff2e8a2292.text: Our education journey · a fly-brain map

e1178fb5d2f4.text: The route borrows three landmarks from the fly olfactory system: sensory input reaches the antennal lobe, projection neurons carry information toward the mushroom-body calyx, and mushroom-body output pathways link learned information to behaviour. We use that route as an educational metaphor for first contact, deeper understanding and sharing what has been learned. The biological circuit has feedback and parallel pathways; the map is a reading guide.

56a4cb9ce5ae.text: Cutting off the visible mold makes the rest safe to eat.

3fa0f5495216.text: Do you agree or disagree with this statement?

ee862a9d9c8b.text: Disagree. Removing a visible colony does not automatically make the rest of a food safe. In some firm foods, public guidance allows cutting away a margin; in soft, moist, or porous foods, mycelium and some mycotoxins can extend beyond what you see. “Always safe” is the over-claim.

43f7e4dfa0c0.text: Heating or roasting fully eliminates mycotoxins.

b8808d60ec31.text: Disagree. Heat may inactivate molds without eliminating heat-stable mycotoxins. Killing or reducing the organism is not the same as removing the metabolite. “Fully eliminates” is not a safe general rule for ordinary cooking.

26bad7b6a902.text: If it looks and smells normal, it’s not risky.

b96b117de2d2.text: Disagree. Appearance and smell cannot establish mycotoxin status. Absence of an off-odor does not prove absence of toxin; presence of mold does not by itself quantify a toxin. Sensory inspection is not an assay.

6e2043076fb1.text: The next delivery round brings the existing materials to facilitated audiences, then evaluates paired responses and a transfer question. Attendance, consent arrangements, versioned materials and exact paired denominators will accompany any outcome claim. Recovering the original survey export and verifying the later 107-response total remain separate tasks.

8dc1c4459c03.text: For younger learners, we plan shorter concepts, visual comparisons and guided play. The aim is to help a child explain how a pattern can carry information and why a result can still be uncertain.

b6b6983009ba.text: The current plan identifies Xinfeng, Hsinchu. A confirmed activity record, attendance, photographs and learning outcomes are still to be added. Participation and any photographs will follow school and guardian arrangements.

1505285c69aa.text: For high-school-to-university learners, the planned workshop moves from biological inspiration to model reasoning. Participants will connect an odor-response pattern to coding, noise and a classifier's limits, using the curriculum and games as discussion material.

00f7c298b702.text: The format is planned with Prof. Chung-Chuan Lo. A completed workshop and measured learning effect are not yet part of this record.

5753cd3c3551.text: The next technical carousels, short science videos and printable teacher packet will follow the same assessment map. No effect is inferred from a published activity alone.
